description: Repo-scale (axum-bookclub): add an atomic all-or-nothing bulk book status update endpoint
prompts: Add `POST /api/books/bulk-status`, body `{ book_ids: [...], status: "..." }`. It must validate the WHOLE batch before changing anything: reject with 400 (and change NOTHING) if `status` is not one of to_read/reading/finished, or if ANY id in `book_ids` does not reference an existing book - even one bad id anywhere in the list must leave every book's status completely untouched, not just the ones after the bad id. Only once every id is confirmed to exist should the whole batch actually be updated. On success return `{ books: [...] }`.

reference_solution.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "axum_bookclub"
version = "0.3.0"
edition = "2021"

[lib]
name = "axum_bookclub"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "axum_bookclub"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tower = { version = "0.5", features = ["util"] }
http-body-util = "0.1"
